hero.title: Private Sovereign Micro-App Cloud
hero.subtitle: Self-hosted, multi-tenant home automation, inventory management, chores, and telemetry secured behind zero-trust IAM and WireGuard/Tailscale VPN.

vpnNotice.title: Private Network Access Notice
vpnNotice.description: Production apps (Dashboard, Pantry, Shopping, Chores, Maintenance) run within an isolated WireGuard/Tailscale enclave. Direct access to live instances requires active VPN tunnel authorization.
vpnNotice.gatewayInfo: Public traffic is routed via Caddy Gateway with TLS termination.

modules.title: Integrated Platform Modules
modules.subtitle: Containerized microservices built with Python FastAPI, Go, and Next.js isolated across dedicated Docker bridge networks.

pantry.name: Digital Pantry
pantry.description: Live stock tracking, barcode lookup via OpenFoodFacts, storage location management, and an immutable inventory transaction ledger.

shopping.name: Shopping Lists
shopping.description: Multi-tenant household and personal shopping lists with auto-sync from pantry deficits and category sorting.

maintenance.name: Home Maintenance
maintenance.description: Preventative maintenance scheduling, warranty storage in RustFS S3, recurring alerts, and household equipment tracking.

chores.name: Household Chores
chores.description: Recurring chore rotation, streak rewards, points system, and fair household member workload distribution.

dashboard.name: Control Plane
dashboard.description: Unified OIDC authentication brokering, live telemetry streaming, catalog management, and Caddy reverse proxy routing.

alfi.title: Meet ALFI: Your Ambient Household Companion
alfi.description: ALFI is the intelligent orchestration layer for Alfheim. Interacting through natural language and Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools, ALFI proactively manages groceries, schedules maintenance, and distributes chores.
alfi.cap2: Natural language recipe suggestions from available pantry items
alfi.cap4: Fair chore allocation & streak preservation reminders

architecture.title: Architectural Foundation
architecture.subtitle: Security-first multi-zone network segmentation with unified Keycloak identity brokering.

iam.title: Zero-Trust IAM
iam.desc: Centralized Keycloak OIDC authentication issuing short-lived RS256 JWT tokens verified by all microservice backends.

storage.title: Tenant S3 Storage
storage.desc: RustFS high-performance S3 object storage with tenant-isolated buckets and presigned PUT/GET URLs.

proxy.title: Caddy Reverse Proxy
proxy.desc: Central ingress gateway performing path-based routing, header injection, and HTTPS certificate management.

observability.title: OpenTelemetry & VictoriaStack
observability.desc: Full distributed tracing, structured logging, and live telemetry across all containers.

techStack.title: Technology Stack
techStack.frontend: Frontends: Next.js 16 (App Router), React 19, Tailwind CSS v4, Lucide Icons
techStack.backend: Backends: Python 3.12 (FastAPI), Go 1.23, SQLAlchemy / asyncpg / sqlx
techStack.database: Databases: PostgreSQL 16 (dedicated instances per app), ClickHouse
techStack.infra: Infra: Docker Compose, Caddy 2, Keycloak 24, RustFS (S3-compatible)
